rationale_en: Set Q is a code-point range, so the rub el hizb sign (So) and the end-of-ayah sign (Cf) are removed by stage 9, not by strip_controls; the ayah number becomes ASCII. Whitespace is kept, so the leading space stays.

rationale_en: Uthmani spelling: small waw U+06E5 (General_Category Lm, inside set Q) is removed with the harakat, and hamza-below alef folds to bare alef. The marks are already in canonical order, so NFC changes nothing.

author: Bayanat Labs (second agent session, written from docs/SPEC.md without engine access)
label: synthetic/illustrative, authored by Bayanat Labs
rationale_en: U+FDD0 lies inside the presentation-forms block but is a noncharacter: stage 1 drops it and records a rejected span; the alef final form is then mapped.

rationale_en: Code-switching with Devanagari: a ZWNJ or ZWJ after a virama (ccc 9) is meaningful and kept; a ZWNJ between two Latin letters prevents no join and is removed.

author: Bayanat Labs (second agent session, written from docs/SPEC.md without engine access)
label: synthetic/illustrative, authored by Bayanat Labs
rationale_en: The known edge in spec 4.5: the ZWNJ context skips tatweel, the next code point is a space (non-joining), so the ZWNJ is removed even though raw-safe-v1 keeps the tatweel.

rationale_en: Keycap sequences built on Arabic-Indic digits: the digits become ASCII; the variation selector and the enclosing keycap mark are kept.

label: synthetic/illustrative, authored by Bayanat Labs
rationale_en: Line separator, ideographic space and Ogham space mark are White_Space: each run becomes one space and the trailing tab is removed. NFC does not apply the wide compatibility mapping of U+3000.

author: Bayanat Labs (second agent session, written from docs/SPEC.md without engine access)
label: synthetic/illustrative, authored by Bayanat Labs
rationale_en: End of text mark, five pointed star and Arabic full stop are punctuation (Po): each becomes a space and the runs collapse. The poetic verse sign is a symbol (So) and is kept. Taa marbuta becomes heh.

author: Bayanat Labs (second agent session, written from docs/SPEC.md without engine access)
label: synthetic/illustrative, authored by Bayanat Labs
rationale_en: Bismillah ligature, an Arabic Extended-C honorific ligature and the rial sign are in set H: kept and flagged (the rial sign is not mapped because H is excluded from the presentation-form set). The small low word sakta U+10EFD is in set Q and is removed.

author: Bayanat Labs (second agent session, written from docs/SPEC.md without engine access)
label: synthetic/illustrative, authored by Bayanat Labs
rationale_en: Kasra (ccc 32) does not block hamza below (ccc 220), so NFC composes alef + hamza below into U+0625 across the kasra; the composed letter maps to the union of its source spans.

author: Bayanat Labs (second agent session, written from docs/SPEC.md without engine access)

rationale_en: bayanat-norm-v1 applies NFC, not NFKC: E + acute composes, but the fi ligature, fullwidth A and superscript two are kept, and the superscript is not a digit for stage 16.

rationale_en: Alef wasla maps to bare alef; alef with wavy hamza above and below (U+0672, U+0673) are outside the alef_variants set and are kept.

rationale_en: Isolated hamza and yeh-with-hamza medial forms map to U+0621 and U+0626; asr-eval-v1 keeps hamza carriers, so no letter is folded.

label: synthetic/illustrative, authored by Bayanat Labs
rationale_en: Terminal colour codes: ESC and DEL are C0/C1-class controls without White_Space, so raw-safe-v1 drops them as three separate rejected spans; the printable rest of the escape sequence stays.

author: Bayanat Labs (second agent session, written from docs/SPEC.md without engine access)
label: synthetic/illustrative, authored by Bayanat Labs
rationale_en: Subscript alef U+0656 is in set Q and is removed. Wavy hamza below U+065F (a language-specific mark) and hamza below after yeh (no precomposed form; only removed after alef) are kept.
